mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO resource_asset_tag (tag_name, created_at) VALUES (#{tagName}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, tag_name, created_at FROM resource_asset_tag WHERE tag_name IN #{name} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO resource_asset_tag_ref (file_id, resource_asset_tag_id, created_at) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{tagId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT tag_ref.file_id AS fileId, tag.tag_name AS tagName FROM resource_asset_tag_ref tag_ref INNER JOIN resource_asset_tag tag ON tag.id = tag_ref.resource_asset_tag_id WHERE tag_ref.file_id IN #{fileId} ORDER BY tag_ref.file_id ASC, tag_ref.id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT tag.tag_name FROM resource_asset_tag tag INNER JOIN resource_asset_tag_ref tag_ref ON tag_ref.resource_asset_tag_id = tag.id INNER JOIN marketing_template_file file ON file.id = tag_ref.file_id AND file.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY tag.tag_name ASC
